label: preparing
what: Likely a quietly coordinated gathering or event in the great hall for day 1 at eighteen hundred, involving food, lighting and tables, possibly a surprise for me presented as a lighting-and-table inspection. Freight explicitly requested closed entrances and shutters and quiet until eighteen; the neighbour acknowledged being asked to leave preparations undisturbed and is escorting me there. Reports place baker, innkeeper, freight and builder together at the bakery, and the innkeeper referred to a lantern payment involving the neighbour. The precise occasion, and whether all reported bakery activity belongs to this event, are not established. I have no evidence that the secretary knowingly shares the undisclosed purpose; their scheduling assistance appears to concern the inspection I approved.
